pages.text: $(bold)Poultry is butchered differently from livestock$().$(br)After using the $(bold)wide-edged knife$() to get $(bold)chicken blood$(), $(bold)right-click$() to take the chicken down.$(br2)Put $(bold)pure water$() ($(item)flavor_immersed_daily:tidywater$()) into the wood basin, put the chicken back in, then $(bold)right-click to pluck$() it.
After plucking, hang the chicken back on the $(bold)big hook$() and continue butchering and breaking it down.
